mikey: heads-up — ran the HF->Redwood convert + int8 quant pipeline on the new.. tiny-chat model and eval BLEU/chrF dropped ~6 points vs baseline. looks like special tokens got stripped during quant pass.

sara: ugh. which step? tokenizer conversion or quantizer?

mikey: reproducer: convert-tool v0.9.3 -> quantize with q4_0 then package into safetensors shards. noticed warnings about weightname mismatches: `rename_map: {'transformer.wte': 'model.wte'}` logged during shard write. also hub download had a transient 403 for one shard earlier in the job: `GET /safetensors/part-3.safetensors 403` then retry succeeded, but the converter continued.

olga: can you paste the config.json that the converter emitted? chat template mappings often break when keynames change.

mikey: pasted snippet: ```json
{
  "architectures": ["TinyChatLM"],
  "special_tokens_map": {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"},
  "chat_templates": {"default": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"{input}"}]}
}
```

mikey: converter produced a chat template but the tokenizer on load shows `unk_token` mapped to None and the special token ids differ from upstream. suspect the renaming of weight keys (prefixing) + an incomplete shard download caused tokenization metadata to be dropped on merge.

sara: do we have a failing unit test for special tokens during conversion? we should fail fast instead of producing a model with mismatched vocab.

olga: I dug into the safetensors writer: when we merge shards, we currently do a dict update that overwrites `tokenizer.json` if any shard lacks it. if a retry returned an older shard missing tokenizer metadata we end up with an incomplete tokenizer.

mikey: that matches the 403 earlier. Retry succeeded for weights but the metadata blob for part-3 was fetched from cache (stale) and lacked `special_tokens_map`.

dev-convertbot: auto-check triggered: run 2187654321-convert-repro produced diff: `vocab size changed 50256 -> 50252` and `special token <pad> removed` — marking as flaky-conversion and opening issue #INF-3421.

mikey: for now, rollback to convert-tool v0.9.2 fixed the quiet merge behavior and re-run quant experiments. q4_0 run with v0.9.2 restored tokens and eval scores returned to baseline.

olga: action items: (1) patch safetensors merge to prefer non-empty tokenizer metadata and validate special token ids before finishing, (2) add a convert e2e check that fails on vocab-size mismatch, (3) add robust hub-download verification so we don't accept stale cached shards after 403s.

sara: +1. can someone file the PRs and link INF-3421? I'll schedule a quick postmortem in eng-ml to go over the eval regression. :eyes:

mikey: filing PRs now. adding tests and a minimal reproducer and eval logs to the issue. thanks all.
